guidelines.observation: Human-centred, young and vibrant, quirky, fabulous. Customers at the core; social listening and active research. Youthful/young-at-heart Gen Z and Millennials are intended audiences, not validated customer demographics. Positive, energetic creative communication; humour and emotionally engaging experiences. Orange headings, grayscale cutout collage and colourful stickers are visible examples.

Jester archetype: pursue connection/social; core desire enjoyment. Humour, wit, playful spirit, relatable messaging and interactive experiences build connection. Easy-going, jolly, living in the here and now. This is supplied positioning, not proof of consumer response.

Traits: playful, creative, unpredictable, energetic, irreverent. Unexpected touches, bold colours/patterns/textures, community and gently subverting convention. These explain personality; do not interpret irreverence as permission for cruelty or misleading claims.

Spatial/design ingredients: bold vibrant colours; stripes, dots or prints; asymmetrical art and mismatched cushions; vintage with modern or bohemian with industrial; quirky sculptures, oversized art and funky lighting. Keep a coherent palette/theme. Orange = bold, white = openness, grey = neutralise. Borrow principles, not specific third-party artwork or sculptures.

Voice: humorous, irreverent, informal, creative, personable. Witty one-liners, clever wordplay, unexpected jokes/metaphors, conversational approachable language; we/you for connection. Remain useful and clear; do not make unsupported product promises.

Master lowercase Sleepyhead wordmark: orange sleepy and charcoal head with integrated closed-eye ee motif and trademark. Logo anatomy shows clear space; orange labelled Wake Up Actively, grey Fall in Comfort. This screenshot documents artwork; it is not a production vector logo.

Logo construction identifies Migrena Grotesque, bold lowercase wordmark and altered e letters forming closed eyes. Preserve the supplied mark, proportions and clear space. Diagram uses an e-based spacing construction; no numeric minimum for full wordmark is established here. USE IT WISELY display styling is a page example, not permission to add shadows to the logo.

Shown logo variants: master, reverse on orange, reverse on black, single colour, positive white-on-black, greyscale, single-colour reverse, negative black-on-white, outline. Prefer master for general communication; use an appropriate authentic variant. Screenshots do not supply usable original logo files or grant permission to redraw the mark.

Logo prohibitions: poor-contrast backgrounds, rotation, bevel/emboss, drop shadow, altered colours, busy photographs/patterns. Right-hand text suggests contrasting solid backgrounds, a slightly transparent patch, alternative variants and high contrast. Conflict: the client scene-execution policy prohibits artificial patches/haze/fades to rescue copy/logo contrast. In scenes use real wall/backdrop space or permitted text/logo treatment; preserve the source conflict instead of silently merging the rules.

Digital monogram is the closed-eye ee symbol. App-icon diagram and prose specify 32x32; favicon diagrams show 16x16. Preserve this context-specific discrepancy: do not announce a universal 16px minimum. No distortion or stretching; retain brand colours and contrast. No actual icon/font/vector asset is supplied.
Social profile examples favour the ee monogram in square/circular contexts. Tiny full wordmark examples are flagged low visibility. Maintain legibility at display size and use authentic artwork.

Social posts: simplified monogram prominent, unobscured, consistent in size/position/orientation, without interfering with composition or text. Sample playful orange-sofa people image plus green/brown sofa imagery show applications, not current exact-SKU evidence. The sample serif headline is not a replacement for the named brand typefaces.

Brand typography: Migrena Grotesque, regular/italic, medium/italic, semibold/italic, bold/italic. Web typography: Source Sans Pro, light/italic, regular/italic, semibold/italic, bold/italic. Font binaries/licences are absent; do not claim installed fonts, licence clearance or exact font rendering.

Primary palette: Vermilion/Giants Orange RGB 241,90,34, HEX #F15A22, CMYK 0,80,100,0; playful/lively. Charcoal/Metal Grey RGB 65,64,66, HEX #414042, CMYK 0,0,0,90; neutraliser. Titanium/Classic White RGB 255,255,255 and CMYK 0,0,0,0, clean/airy dominant. ERROR: white is printed HEX #231F20, a dark colour; RGB implies #FFFFFF. Store both source values and mark #FFFFFF as an interpretation pending source correction. Do not use #231F20 as white. Printed Pantone values are source specifications only, not verified conversion or print proof.

Complementary palette printed codes: #004F2D, #D87CAC, #FFDA22, #ACBDBA, #FFDCCC, #531CB3, #404796, #06D6A0, #610345, #BDD358, #3FA7D6, #FFBE0B, #D741A7, #8B9474, #00A878, #5E0B15, #944BBB, #FEEA00, #08A045. Orange also pictured. A library of supporting choices, not instruction to use every colour in one room or recolour the logo/product. Preserve exact source codes; screenshots are not calibrated colour measurements.
